name: claude-mods
description: Every mod in this repo, in one marketplace: the personal mods at the top level plus the bundled benai-mods collection. Point cloud sessions or org managed settings at this repo to load them.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Cache meter above the prompt with refresh, keep-warm, compress, and a one-press handoff to continue in a new session.

plugins.name: close-out-check
plugins.description: After each turn that changed code, flags a stale CHANGELOG / version / handoff note and offers a one-press fix.

plugins.name: effort-advisor
plugins.description: Rates each new prompt's effort and offers to switch before Claude starts.

plugins.name: mods-panel
plugins.description: A Mods button above the prompt opens a side panel that switches each mod on or off.

plugins.name: review-system
plugins.description: Evals-first build and review loop: risk rating, approved evals and mockups, builder/verifier/reviewer rounds, a first-time-user test, and fix-a-bug.

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: Expands a bare 'deploy it' / 'ship it' / 'merge it' into the full commit-PR-merge-deploy-verify checklist.

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Keeps rate-limit usage in the status line, warns before agent fan-out near a limit, and blocks it at the edge.

plugins.name: where-are-we
plugins.description: At session start, shows branch, dirty files, upstream changes, PR state, gh auth and dev servers in a band.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Shapes a long, loose prompt into a four-part brief.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, above the prompt.

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane listing the to-do list, connectors, context files and skills this chat used.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 250k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat and starts a new chat with it.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A task progress bar above the prompt and a side pane with one live card per subagent.

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: A Mods pane that finds every mod and turns each one on or off.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: /screen-share draws emails, phone numbers, money amounts and names as shaded bars on screen for recording.
